description: Level 11 — Pronoun Resolution Foundation. A general mechanism (not per-case routing) that resolves pronouns ('you', 'I', 'they', 'we', 'he', 'she', 'it') to their referents using Grammar API + [repo] cache. This is a utility level — all later levels benefit from it automatically. Follows the principle: global problems need general mechanisms.

data.description: Core idea: when someone speaks, resolve what each pronoun in their sentence refers to. Cache results in [Pronoun:Cache] keyed by pronoun word + caller context. Later rules query [repo] [GET] [Pronoun:Cache].
System container: when someone says something to Susie, cache the basic pronoun context. 'you'/'your' → Susie, 'I'/'me'/'my' → the speaker.
When Susie speaks to someone, update the pronoun cache for the new context (now 'I' = Susie, 'you' = listener)
Pronoun resolution: given a pronoun word, look up who it refers to in the current speaker's context. This is the general [Pronoun:Resolve] command.
Route: 'their X' means X belongs to 'them'. General possessive resolution.
commands: dev says to Susie : if someone mentions their something
dev says to Susie : then what belongs to them is their thing

data.description: Route: when someone is expressing their feeling, the feeling is theirs
commands: dev says to Susie : if someone is expressing their gratitude
dev says to Susie : then the gratitude is theirs
dev says to Susie : if someone is expressing their apology
dev says to Susie : then the apology is theirs
dev says to Susie : if someone is expressing their regret
dev says to Susie : then the regret is theirs

data.description: Route: map common pronoun-containing phrases to their resolved forms. 'someone thanks you' → 'they are expressing their gratitude to you' (gratitude = theirs). This connects Level 3 politeness hooks to pronoun context.
commands: dev says to Susie : if someone thanks you
dev says to Susie : then they are expressing their gratitude to you
dev says to Susie : if someone says sorry to you
dev says to Susie : then they are expressing their regret to you
dev says to Susie : if someone greets you
dev says to Susie : then they are greeting you
dev says to Susie : if someone says goodbye to you
dev says to Susie : then they are saying farewell to you

data.description: The pronoun 'it' resolution: 'it' refers to the most recently mentioned thing in context. Cache the last-discussed topic.
Resolution: when someone uses 'it', look up the last topic
commands: dev says to Susie : if someone talks about it
dev says to Susie : then you can resolve it from the last topic

data.description: Special case: quoted speech — when 'you' appears inside a quote, it does NOT refer to Susie. Higher levels can override. This is a placeholder hook for later edge case refinement.
commands: dev says to Susie : if someone quotes someone else
dev says to Susie : then the words in the quote are from the original speaker
